message:
Command `python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src/wav.c","function":"wav_open","line":254,"var":"error","code":"error = wavlike_ima_init (psf, blockalign, framesperblock);","note":"A WAV IMA ADPCM file routes opening into the IMA codec initializer using header-derived block size and samples-per-block."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/ima_adpcm.c","function":"wavlike_ima_init","line":120,"var":"error","code":"if ((error = ima_reader_init (psf, blockalign, samplesperblock))) return error;","note":"Read mode forwards the same attacker-controlled parameters into the reader setup."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/ima_adpcm.c","function":"ima_reader_init","line":185,"var":"pimasize","code":"pimasize = sizeof (IMA_ADPCM_PRIVATE) + blockalign * psf->sf.channels + 3 * psf->sf.channels * samplesperblock;","note":"The codec object size is computed from the file header; a tiny samples-per-block still leaves later decode logic believing a full block exists."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/ima_adpcm.c","function":"ima_reader_init","line":228,"var":"pima->decode_block","code":"pima->decode_block = wavlike_ima_decode_block;","note":"The WAV IMA decoder is selected and the first block is decoded immediately during initialization."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/ima_adpcm.c","function":"wavlike_ima_decode_block","line":408,"var":"pima->block","code":"if ((k = psf_fread (pima->block, 1, pima->blocksize, psf)) != pima->blocksize) ...","note":"The decoder reads the block header and payload from attacker-controlled bytes."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/ima_adpcm.c","function":"wavlike_ima_decode_block","line":431,"var":"pima->samples[k]","code":"pima->samples [indx] = bytecode & 0x0F; ... pima->samples [indx] = (bytecode >> 4) & 0x0F;","note":"Packed nibbles from the block are expanded into the sample array without validating the block is large enough for the advertised sample count."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/ima_adpcm.c","function":"wavlike_ima_decode_block","line":443,"var":"k","code":"for (k = pima->channels ; k < (pima->samplesperblock * pima->channels) ; k ++)","note":"The decode loop iterates using samples-per-block from the file; a malformed header can make downstream code rely on inconsistent block layout."},
{"step":8,"file":"src/ima_adpcm.c","function":"wavlike_ima_decode_block","line":456,"var":"pima->samples[k]","code":"pima->samples [k] = predictor;","note":"The decoded predictor values are written back into the sample buffer, and the out-of-bounds write occurs when the block layout and derived sample count disagree."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
print('trace written')
PY
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json && printf '\n---POC HEX---\n' && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
b=Path('/workspace/poc.bin').read_bytes()
print(b.hex())
PY` executed with exit code -1.
